candidate_relations.reason: Perforated appendicitis is distinct from the benchmark urachal cyst and does not identify a urachal remnant lesion.
Appendicitis with a periappendiceal abscess is anatomically and etiologically distinct from a midline urachal cyst above the bladder.
Intussusception does not correspond to the benchmark urachal cyst or the described midline supravesical mass.
A perforated appendiceal abscess is a separate entity from a urachal cyst.
Appendicitis with perforation and peritonitis does not identify the benchmark urachal cyst.
This identifies the benchmark urachal cyst and adds infection, which is compatible with the fever, elevated C-reactive protein, acute abdomen, and midline mass above the bladder.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Urachal cyst with compatible infectious complication
